## Workflow 3 — Monthly Digest

Handoff §7 Workflow 3. Reads the index only —
zero Slack history calls.

### Two ways in, one code path
* **Schedule** — 09:00 Manila on the LAST WEEKDAY
  of the month. Cron cannot express that, so
  the trigger fires daily from the 25th and
  `Normalize Request` stops every day but one.
* **Execute Workflow** — called by the Events
  Endpoint when someone DMs Posty "digest".

`Normalize Request` tells them apart and decides
recipients. Everything after it is shared, so the
scheduled and on-demand digests cannot drift.

### ⚠️ Recipients: tara only for now
§14.11 — preview to tara before enabling regie.
Add `U025597KZ` to SCHEDULED_RECIPIENTS in
`Normalize Request` once the first run reads well.

### Buckets
`>= 90` escalated, `45..89` flagged, `< 45`
omitted (§7 step 3). DELETED and CANCELLED rows
are excluded everywhere.

### Long sections split
Slack caps a text block at 5,000 chars. Sections
split across messages rather than dropping rows —
the rows a silent truncation would drop are
exactly the ones nobody is looking at.
